fact: The September 2023 restructuring paper says the Social Registry was extended to the whole country in December 2022, about 3 million households (9 million individuals) were enrolled by August 2023, enrolment requires the household head's and each member's DCSIN issued by the National Population Registry, and AMO-TADAMON, DAAM and student stipends use the registry for new beneficiaries.
title: Restructuring Paper on a Proposed Project Restructuring of Identity and Targeting for Social Protection Project (P155198)
